adversary_model: A previously activated import is counted even though challenge or rollback posture was not rechecked at the quorum boundary.
hidden_trap_summary: Rollback can be bypassed if it is checked at activation time only and not replayed at final recomputation entry.
expected_safe_behavior: block participation when challenge or rollback posture is open/stale
exclude the import gate from eligible_live_imports
publish failed-gate summary for the exclusion
unacceptable_behavior: count a stale activation after challenge opens
ignore supersession or rollback at quorum boundary
raise live floor without failed-gate summary
measurement_method: Audit and floor engine require challenge_rollback_rechecked=true on the quorum participation object and still honor challenge exclusions.
